verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client for GitHub collaboration: reviewing pull requests, triaging issues, notifications and Copilot agent tasks. Saving SSH hosts and connecting to them with one tap is a terminal/SSH-client capability, which is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows the app ships any SSH or host-connection feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to a saved host with one tap without re-entering credentials
